column1: # Expected import edges for the bindings trap fixture (python).
# from<TAB>to, one per line. scripts/check.sh asserts this set exactly:
# a missing line is an edge the extractor stopped finding, an extra line
# is an edge it invented. Both are regressions.
# Written from the fixture sources alone, by an independent oracle that
# never saw the extractor or its output; the two are reconciled separately.
# from M import X lists both M (app/models/__init__.py) and the submodule M.X.
# app/models/thing.py: from . import thing names the file itself - no self edge.
# app/loader.py is stored CRLF; its backslash continuations still join.
# Bare undotted os, a_package_not_in_this_tree, a_missing_reporting_lib: no edge.
# Regenerate deliberately, never reflexively - the point of the file is
# that it does not move when the extractor changes.
